history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration update the budget guide to request respective special political missions to conduct a comprehensive analysis of their own communications and information technology equipment demand plan and to align the plan with budget proposals and implementation in the future.
history.administration_response: The Administration considers the recommendation to be implemented and requests its closure. The budget guide has been updated to include additional instructions for special political missions to conduct a comprehensive analysis of the communications and information technology equipment demand plan and to align the plan with their budget proposals and implementation. To strengthen oversight of ICT spending across the Secretariat by the Chief Information Technology Officer, all special political missions were required, for the 2026 programme budget, to submit their proposed ICT projects and activities to the Office of Information and Communications Technology for review and technical clearance prior to the submission of the related resource requirements to the Office of Programme Planning, Finance and Budget.
history.board_assessment: Given that the 2026 budget preparation guide has been updated to include additional instructions requesting special political missions to conduct a comprehensive analysis of the communications and information technology equipment demand plan, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
